core.title: Store appendices in the appendix subdirectory of the artifact they describe
core.given: An appendix (a mockup, diagram or supplementary file) describes an artifact of the plan structure, wherever it is currently stored.
core.when: You plan, add, move, rename, edit or review it, or come across it.
core.then: Store the appendix in the appendix subdirectory of the artifact it describes, at the level-specific location the profile defines for that artifact's level.
prefer: Use the most specific artifact level the appendix describes, and create that level's appendix subdirectory if it is missing.
Move any misplaced appendix you find to that location, including ones in shared or central folders.
avoid: Placing an appendix directly in the described artifact's own directory instead of its appendix subdirectory.
Storing an appendix at another artifact level or in a shared central folder.
core.why: Co-located appendices keep artifacts self-contained and make supplementary content discoverable relative to the artifact.
evidence: Every appendix file has as its parent directory the appendix subdirectory of the artifact it describes, at the level-specific location the profile defines for that artifact kind. This holds for existing, edited and newly added files, wherever they were found.
verification: For every appendix file, verify that its parent directory is the appendix subdirectory of the artifact it describes, at the level-specific location the profile defines (layout.appendix_dir).

The check is repository-wide: it scans the scope the profile designates for repository-wide checks (roots.scan), not only changed files or the plan tree, so pre-existing misplaced appendices are reported too, including those in shared directories outside the plan tree.
An edit of an appendix already stored in the correct appendix subdirectory is an applicable, passing case, not an out-of-scope one.

Deciding that a file is an appendix, and which artifact it describes, is a semantic step: path-based discovery hints are hints only, not scope gates. Appendix files and the artifact each one describes are identified by the profile's appendix filename pattern (suffix.appendix_pattern), and the artifact identifier embedded in the filename must match the artifact that owns the appendix directory; when that identifier is missing or ambiguous, which artifact the appendix describes is a matter of review judgment (the llm_judged activation fact).

Applicability depends only on which artifact an appendix describes, not on where it currently sits: the change fact identifies violations only, and the rule still applies (and is satisfied) when none is present.

values: appendix file present outside the appendix subdirectory of the artifact it describes
appendix file in the appendix subdirectory of a different artifact level than the one it describes
appendix file stored outside the plan tree (e.g. in a shared or central directory)
an appendix describes a plan-structure artifact that does not match its storage location

fires: A mockup, diagram or supplementary file is added for an artifact of the plan structure.
An appendix file sits directly in the described artifact's directory instead of in its appendix subdirectory, whether it was just added or already existed.
An appendix is stored in the appendix subdirectory of a different artifact level than the one it describes.
An existing appendix describing an artifact of the plan structure is found in an external shared directory outside the plan tree, even if no one moved it in this change.
A reviewer or planner finds an existing misplaced appendix while reviewing or editing, even if it was not touched in this change.
An appendix is moved or renamed.
The content of an appendix that is already stored in the correct appendix subdirectory is edited. The rule applies and is satisfied as long as the file stays there.
doesNotFire: Non-appendix plan artifacts (manifests, workplans, acceptance files) are added or edited in their normal locations.
Unrelated non-appendix code changes are made outside the plan tree, and no appendix describing a plan-structure artifact is added, moved, edited or inspected.

profileRequirements.meaning: For each artifact level, the directory in which appendices describing an artifact of that level are stored: the appendix subdirectory directly under the described artifact's own directory.

The filename pattern by which a file is recognized as an appendix and the identifier of the artifact it describes is read out of the filename, so a check can pair each appendix with its owning artifact.
profileRequirements.bunValue: {artifact}_{type}_{slug}.ext (e.g. E023_mockup_payment-error.png); the artifact prefix in the filename should match the artifact that owns the appendices/ directory

profileRequirements.meaning: The scope a repository-wide storage check scans.
profileRequirements.bunValue: the whole repository, not only the diff or the wagon tree

proposedKeys.meaning: For each artifact level, the directory in which appendices (supplementary files describing an artifact) are stored: an appendix subdirectory of the described artifact's own directory.
proposedKeys.whyNoExistingKey: The layout group covers wagon, feature, commons and plan-item directories, but no key says where supplementary material describing an artifact lives; the entire obligation of this rule is that per-level appendix location, so composing wagon_dir/feature_dir/plan_item plus a directory name would not cover the component level and would invent structure the profile does not have.

proposedKeys.meaning: The filename pattern that identifies a file as an appendix (supplementary material describing a plan-structure artifact) and embeds the identifier of the artifact it describes.
proposedKeys.bunValue: {artifact}_{type}_{slug}.ext (e.g. E023_mockup_payment-error.png); the artifact prefix in the filename should match the artifact that owns the appendices/ directory
proposedKeys.whyNoExistingKey: suffix.<file_kind> lists suffixes or name patterns per file kind, but its file_kind parameters contain no appendix kind: appendices are supplementary files describing plan artifacts (mockups, diagrams), not plan artifacts themselves, so suffix.plan_artifact does not cover them; and no existing key encodes the ownership link (the artifact identifier in the filename) that the storage check must verify.

neutralityNotes: The concrete directory name 'appendices/' and the four level-specific location templates exist in the core only through the proposed profile key layout.appendix_dir (instantiating it with the Bun values reproduces bun.json's then, evidence[0] and verifier_detail[1] exactly). The described artifact levels (wagon, WMBT, feature, component) are generalized to 'artifacts of the plan structure' and enumerated by that same key. Identifying appendix files and their owning artifact flows through the proposed profile key suffix.appendix_pattern ({artifact}_{type}_{slug}.ext with the artifact prefix); only the sibling-rule cross-reference planner.appendix.naming-pattern and the concrete filename example remain bunOnly. The discovery globs of activation.facts[0] and the demo path examples of evidence[1] have no stack-neutral equivalent and remain bunOnly; only their generic principle (hints, not scope gates) survives in verification. bun.json's unless is empty and so is the core's, so no exception was dropped or added; the source declares no automated verifier, and the core's verification describes the check generically without inventing enforcement.
